data.exact_reserve_text: In 2016, there has been an overall improvement of GBP 1.6m (2015: improvement of GBP 16.4m).

prior_year_events.impact_description: increased level of weather related losses impacting Property division, particularly Direct & Facultative business, leading to increased overall impact in profitability for 2015 year of account.
continued positive development in the Energy book with a lower level of large losses, partly offsetting adverse development in other areas.
Aviation book continued to be impacted by market losses during the calendar year, leading to a decision to exit this market from mid-year 2016.

named_events.loss_description: record Hailstorms in Texas contributed to an unprecedented level of small weather events.
unprecedented flooding in Louisiana contributed to an unprecedented level of small weather events.
Hurricane Matthew impacted the primary insurance markets more than the reinsurance markets, contributing to an unprecedented level of small weather events.
2015 year of account is impacted by a number of smaller US weather events, mainly attributable to the Property division.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year strengthening of GBP 18.3m in 2016, primarily driven by adverse development in older underwriting years as calculated from the claims development triangle. This contrasts with a stated net overall improvement of GBP 1.6m in claims provisions. Causes for prior year movements include increased weather-related losses in the Property division for the 2015 year of account, partially offset by positive development in the Energy book. The 2014 year of account closed with a profit of GBP 28.4m.
raw_causal_phrases: 2015 year of account, whilst another benign year for large catastrophe events, is impacted by a number of smaller US weather events.
mainly attributable to the Property division, in particular the Direct & Facultative business, which has experienced an increased level of weather related losses
ongoing competitive pressure in premium rates there has been an increase in the overall impact in profitability.
partly offset by continued positive development in the Energy book which has seen a lower level of large lossest this year.

Aviation book continued to be impacted by market losses during the calendar year, and following unsustainable rate reductions continuing through 2015 and 2016 the Syndicate made the decision to exit this market and close the division from mid-year 2016.
In 2016, there has been an overall improvement of GBP 1.6m

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The calculated gross prior year development of +GBP 18.3m from the claims development triangle on page 16 differs from the narrative statement on page 15 of an 'overall improvement of GBP 1.6m', which is a net figure. The gross figure from the triangle is used as per instructions. LOB movements are qualitative as specific amounts are not quantified.
